text:
Nothing from what you describe is ok.
Not the fact that they are delaying the granting of the A5 until December, and not the fact that your son has no visa until now.
Absolutely outrageous. 
I would say such a blatant violation of your rights calls for legal intervention, but before that maybe your partner (as the Israeli) can try to act more assertively to demand what you deserve.
You can contact AIC for a consultation about this support@aic.org.il
